name: egypt-advisor-tours
description: Egypt Advisor Tours - Travel planning platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.postinstall: node -e "if (process.env.BUILD_CLIENT === 'true') { const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const result = spawnSync('npm', ['run', 'build'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(result.status || 0); } console.log('Skipping client build during postinstall. Set BUILD_CLIENT=true to enable it.');"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client

author: jozoxm
